passages.note: Bill overview lists Ortiz as a co-sponsor of HB2721, a statewide middle-housing zoning mandate.
House Final Reading roll call shows Ortiz voting Y on HB2721.

passages.provision_quote: The municipality may not do any of the following: 1. Discourage the development of middle housing through requirements or actions that individually or cumulatively make impracticable the permitting, siting, or construction of middle housing.
passages.note: Enacted statute bars municipalities from blocking middle housing, the zoning-limit clause the bill removes.

rows.reasoning: HB2721 bars municipalities from zoning rules that block middle housing, the kind of deregulation rung 5 ('at most, cut the regulations and zoning limits that block private building') names, and Ortiz co-sponsored and voted Yes on it. But one deregulation statute cannot show she wants 'at most' this and nothing more market-reliant, so it is on-question but only direction-only.
